summary:
The plan is in plan.md. The building is a narrow SF Italianate row house. A teal false front sits on a dark sea-green garage base, with an angled bay stacked over the drive. A cream stair rises to a recessed porch with two columns.
Gold fish-scale bands and a burgundy frieze run under a deep cream bracketed cornice, with a small pediment on top. A low slate gable hides behind the parapet.
Party walls (ochre and pale blue neighbours) press in on both sides; the deck and long garden are at the back. All colours are teal/gold/burgundy/cream blocks checked with the toolkit; I avoided cyan_terracotta, which renders grey. Teal Italianate row house on a dark sea-green garage base: gold fish-scale bands, burgundy frieze, cream bracketed cornice and pediment, a full-height angled bay, and a cream stair up to a recessed two-column porch.
Fourteen rooms on four levels, with three stair runs and partitions with doorways. Six parts: shell, stairs and partitions, roof, front facade, openings, site.
elements.md has 36 elements, each with its blocks, coordinates, part and helper. plan.md has the palette, vocabulary, rooms and parts. All block ids are known.

summary:
Openings: Openings (parts/openings.mjs) is written: garage door, cellar light, front door pair and transom, bay side and front lights, upper front lights, back windows, French doors and garden-store door, and back sills and hoods at z33. make.sh produced a whole build.nbt, but the Openings line shows 108 REFUSED writes and only 20 placed (back sills and hoods), so no glass or doors landed.
Root cause: shell.mjs carves every opening to explicit minecraft:air, and runParts counts placed air as owned, so later parts cannot write into any opening. Fix belongs in shell.mjs (skip opening cells instead of carving them) or in runParts (air is not ownership); I did not edit either.
Notes appended to plan.md. Checklist and elements 3, 9, 15 not ticked; element 17 is partly built (back sills only).
polish: BLOCKED: 108 opening writes refused because shell.mjs carves every opening to explicit minecraft:air and runParts treats placed air as owned. Needs the shell to skip opening cells, or runParts to stop counting air as ownership. Then rerun ./make.sh; the module needs no change.
